tools.name: get_gitbook_plans
tools.description: Get GitBook's plans and what each one includes, to help decide which plan fits a team's needs.

tools.name: search_gitbook_docs
tools.description: Search GitBook's product documentation and return matching pages with links to their Markdown versions. Use this to answer questions about how GitBook works, its features, API, or configuration.

query.description: What to search for, e.g. 'git sync monorepo' or 'custom domain'.

tools.name: start_gitbook_docs_site
tools.description: Get the steps and links needed to create a GitBook documentation site, including sign-up and importing existing content.

source.description: Where the existing content lives, if any - e.g. 'github', 'confluence', 'notion', 'markdown', 'none'.
